_about: RULING 1 (2026-11-20). WRITTEN by app/src/components/chart/engine/ast/windowWarmupEdge.test.js (WINDOW_WARMUP_EDGE_WRITE=1), READ by it and by tests/test_pine_window_warmup_edge.py. `bars`: a chart cut from a longer history (off the listing). Per function: `tree` (its canonical call in `nz(…, sentinel)`), `served` (this lane's column, chart + a Pine document off the listing: barIndexAbsolute, varOriginAbsolute), `named` (whether it named `history:before-chart`) and `listing` (the same from the listing: nothing withheld for a window). The Python lane (ast_interpret.interpret, newest_bar_is_forming false) must equal `served` and `named`, and withhold nothing from the listing either.
